title: Most random thing I didn't know I needed!
text: Most random thing I didn't know I needed!. This might be the weirdest review ever but I bought this on a whim because I thought it looked cute and I loved it! From assembling it myself which was super easy (easier than I thought it'd be) and fun to placing the mugs on it to how it looks now which is just perfect!, plus, it doesn't really use that much space which is something I was worried about when I bought it. It's the perfect size and looks super cute! I really loved it! It's probably a great gift as well!
